```{r}
rnd_taphor_data <- function(size) {
  # Generate the initial dataset
  data <- rnd_taphor_site_data()

  # Loop through the specified size to add additional count columns
  for (i in 1:(size - 1)) {
    new_data <- rnd_taphor_site_data()
    data <- data %>%
      mutate(!!paste0("count", i + 1) := new_data$count)
  }

  return(data)
}
```

```{r}
tapho.load.db <- function(data) {
  tb <- tapho.load(data[, 1:2])

  for (i in 3:ncol(data)) {
    one_column <- data[, c(1,i)]
    one_column <- one_column %>% rename(count = !!paste0("count", i-1))
    tb_one <- tapho.load(one_column)
    tb <- tb %>% add_row(tb_one)
  }

  return(tb)
}
```

```{r}
read_excel_sheets <- function(file_path) {
  # Read the Excel file
  excel_data <- readxl::read_excel(file_path, sheet = NULL)

  # Process each sheet
  result_list <- lapply(excel_data, function(sheet) {
    # Convert the sheet to a data frame
    sheet_df <- as.data.frame(sheet)
    print(sheet_df)

    # Process the sheet using tapho.load.db
    processed_sheet <- tapho.load.db(sheet_df)

    return(processed_sheet)
  })

  return(result_list)
}
```

```{r}
file_path <- "test_excel_file.xlsx"
# Define the function to read an Excel file with multiple sheets
read_excel_sheets <- function(file_path) {
  # Read the Excel file
  excel_data <- readxl::read_excel(file_path, sheet = NULL)

  # Process each sheet
  result_list <- lapply(excel_data, function(sheet) {
    # Convert the sheet to a data frame
    sheet_df <- as.data.frame(sheet)

    # Process the sheet using tapho.load.db
    processed_sheet <- tapho.load.db(sheet_df)

    return(processed_sheet)
  })

  return(result_list)
}
```

```{r}
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)

# Define the function to read an Excel file with multiple sheets
read_excel_sheets <- function(file_path) {
  
  # Get all sheet names in the Excel file
  sheet_names <- readxl::excel_sheets(file_path)
  
  # Read each sheet, process it, and store in a list
  processed_list <- lapply(sheet_names, function(sname) {
    
    # Read the current sheet
    sheet_data <- readxl::read_excel(file_path, sheet = sname)
    
    # Process it using your tapho.load.db() function
    processed_sheet <- tapho.load.db(sheet_data)
    
    # Optionally, you might want to keep track of which sheet it came from
    # processed_sheet <- processed_sheet %>% 
    #   mutate(sheet_name = sname)
    
    processed_sheet
  })
  
  # Combine all processed sheets into one tibble
  combined_df <- bind_rows(processed_list)
  
  return(combined_df)
}

# Example usage
file_path <- "test_excel_file.xlsx"

# Read and process all sheets, then combine
processed_data <- read_excel_sheets(file_path)

# Inspect the combined tibble
print(processed_data)
```
